wus.title: 1a GitLab final-review references and provider-pinned metadata
wus.notes: TDD through scripted glab CLI. Normalize full URLs/numeric refs; arbitrary authors, forks, source/target SHAs and projects, descriptions/intent refs, re-fetch. Read-only provider access. Original seeds: scripts/review-gate.py, scripts/rg_store.py, scripts/ocr_verdict.py, tests normal-entrypoint stubs are covered by S16-01B/C/D.

wus.title: 1b immutable whole-repo materialization and merge-base diffs
wus.notes: TDD with temporary real Git repositories. Clean disposable trees from pinned SHAs only, full merge-base diffs and complete checkout; deterministic cleanup. Reuse clone lifecycle seam without changing pre-push behavior.

wus.title: 1c versioned SQLite run/store/contract identity and reports
wus.notes: TDD with temporary SQLite. WAL, transactions, FKs, bounded writer retries, migrations; store_instance_id, run identity, units/evidence/warnings/findings/stops/publications, versioned initial contract and machine/human reports. Preserve historical records. Read scripts/rg_store.py for the external store-root convention only; do not modify it.

wus.title: 1d standalone final-review CLI and one correctness lens
wus.notes: Normal CLI seam with temporary real Git repos, scripted providers/workers and SQLite. One GitLab standalone item, full-range evidence, independent correctness lens, all findings through compute_verdict, reports and nonzero failures. Explicit incomplete until mandatory features exist; minimal monolith dispatch only.

wus.title: 2a independent full static lens aggregation
wus.notes: Correctness, standards, docs/domain, tests, security, compatibility/migration and intent lenses independently complete/degrade before aggregation; every result validated/falsified and judged only by compute_verdict. Missing mandatory lens means incomplete, no small-diff exemption. Read tests/test_verdict_coverage.py as a validation seam only.

wus.title: 2b complete-repository context, intent, submodules and LFS
wus.notes: On-demand whole-repo/callers/tests plus unchanged ADR/glossary/standards; mandatory-attempt linked intent warnings, no invented requirements or prose graph edges; recursive submodules and required LFS, irrelevant binary warning only after proof, missing required content incomplete.

wus.title: 3a declared required verification in isolated credential-free clones
wus.notes: Discover declared suites/CI without guessing; isolated dedicated clones and credential scrubbing, cleanup on every exit, exactly one failure rerun. Reproduced failure blocking evidence through verdict stream; unexecutable required suite incomplete, absent suite explicit.

wus.title: 3b SPEC-15 dynamic checks for final-review units
wus.notes: Explicit final-review opt-in only. Reuse one-shot selector, existing tests/race detectors/ephemeral probes and exactly one rerun; separate credential-free scratch clone per unit, no probe in evidence/source, flake/uncovered/selector/probe/timeout warnings and telemetry, never required-suite degradation. Read tests/test_parallel_checks.py as a seam only; S16-03A owns edits to it.

wus.title: 4a finding memory, SHA freshness and waiver isolation
wus.notes: Carry unresolved same-store findings with content/evidence anchors; rerun continuity, positive resolution/falsification only, stale re-fetch of full revision tuple and explicit restart. Local waiver visible but excluded from official suppression; store-boundary trust qualifiers.

wus.title: 4b scoped structured critical stops and safe completion
wus.notes: Ordinary findings never short-circuit safe mandatory work. Supervisor maps evidence-backed STOP to affected scopes/dependents only, records skipped mandatory work and original critical finding, and returns incomplete.

wus.title: 5 GitLab final statuses, degradation and same-store run ordering
wus.notes: Scripted provider doubles only. Dedicated final status context with run/store/contract/revision identity; publish after final/trust calculation, permission loss local-only/unenforced, monotonic same-store supersession and stale-older-worker protection.

wus.title: 6a GitLab linear graph discovery and corrected commands
wus.notes: Provider source/target edges only; supplied ancestors/descendants discovery, omissions return complete corrected command. Reject duplicate/cycle/gap/branch/mixed target/root/inconsistent ordering/prose-only edges without auto-add/reorder.

wus.title: 6b ordered combined/prospective composition and initial correctness
wus.notes: Ordered pinned-head composition against root target and disposable prospective current-target integration; conflict/unreproducible tree incomplete, no auto-resolution. Initial combined correctness plus cross-item/integration lens path, explicitly unenforced until S16-07.

wus.title: 7 complete GitLab individual+combined final orchestration
wus.notes: All static/dynamic/required checks at individual and combined levels, linked reports, freshness/memory/scoped stops and cleanup across graph. Publish per-item final status only when both levels pass and trust permits; preserve individual defects despite combined repair.

wus.title: 8 GitHub standalone+stack/fork/status parity via common adapter
wus.notes: Scripted gh fixtures/test doubles only. Implement metadata/revision/publication transport parity for standalone, stacks, forks and permission degradation; shared graph, scope, verdict, memory, stop, cleanup and trust semantics unchanged. Follow existing gh/glab conventions in scripts/ocr_forge.py and scripts/rg_ticket_fetch.py; do not modify ocr_forge.py.

wus.title: 9a versioned acceptance registry and all 21 scenario definitions
wus.notes: Database migrations seed stable keys, expected states, evidence, cleanup/warning/trust assertions and retained results for all 21 specified scenarios; scenario dispatch uses normal CLI and real-model harness seams with provider writes doubled.

wus.title: 9b database-backed operator views and historical migrations
wus.notes: Contract show, acceptance list and auditable current/historical run report views from SQLite; upgrades preserve prior contract/acceptance versions. Minimal CLI dispatch; no parallel canonical Markdown manuals.

wus.title: 10a real-model and deterministic SPEC-16 acceptance
wus.notes: Extend real-model harness with real Git history and deterministic recorded GitLab/GitHub metadata. Execute all 21 acceptance scenarios with no live mutation; persist evidence under run contract/acceptance versions. Full real-model+deterministic acceptance.

wus.title: 10b1 successor ADR and final-review observability
wus.notes: Complete structured telemetry for graph/coverage/dynamic/stale/stops/store/publication without secrets or unrelated source; successor ADR for command/store/trust/publication. Focused tests only; S16-10B2 owns full regression.

wus.title: 10b2 full pytest/ruff and SPEC-15/pre-push regression verification
wus.notes: Run complete pytest and ruff suites plus real-model/deterministic acceptance evidence and SPEC-15 regression checks. Prove unchanged pre-push defaults and no source/provider mutations. Read-only verification; do not stage .kimchi/.
